title.en: Choice of form of business organisation

hook.en: A tailor, a family jewellers, a group of dairy farmers and a car maker all need different forms of organisation. The right choice depends on a few key factors.
hook.kn: ದರ್ಜಿ, ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಆಭರಣ ಅಂಗಡಿ, ಹಾಲು ಉತ್ಪಾದಕರ ಗುಂಪು ಮತ್ತು ಕಾರು ತಯಾರಕ – ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ ಸಂಘಟನಾ ಸ್ವರೂಪ ಬೇಕು. ಸರಿಯಾದ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಕೆಲವು ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸಿದೆ.

objectives.en: List the factors that decide the choice of form

narration.en: A tailor, a family jewellers, a group of dairy farmers and a car maker all need different forms of organisation. The right choice depends on a few key factors.
narration.kn: ದರ್ಜಿ, ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಆಭರಣ ಅಂಗಡಿ, ಹಾಲು ಉತ್ಪಾದಕರ ಗುಂಪು ಮತ್ತು ಕಾರು ತಯಾರಕ – ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ ಸಂಘಟನಾ ಸ್ವರೂಪ ಬೇಕು. ಸರಿಯಾದ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಕೆಲವು ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸಿದೆ.

body.en: The choice depends on the cost and ease of setting up, the liability the owners can accept, the need for continuity, the management ability required, the capital needed, the degree of control the owners want, and the nature of the business. No single form is best for every business.

points.en: Cost and ease of setting up

narration.en: The choice depends on the cost and ease of setting up, the liability the owners can accept, the need for continuity, the management ability required, the capital needed, the degree of control the owners want, and the nature of the business. No single form is best for every business.
narration.kn: ಸ್ಥಾಪನಾ ವೆಚ್ಚ, ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ, ನಿರಂತರತೆ, ನಿರ್ವಹಣಾ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ, ಬಂಡವಾಳ, ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಮತ್ತು ವ್ಯವಹಾರದ ಸ್ವರೂಪ – ಇವು ಆಯ್ಕೆಯನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

problem.en: Suggest a form: (a) Anil wants to open a small photocopy shop with ₹50,000 and keep all decisions to himself. (b) Two friends, one with ₹5 lakh and one with technical skill, want to start a repair workshop. (c) Promoters need ₹200 crore for a steel plant and want limited liability.

steps.en: (a) Small capital, full control, easy formation: sole proprietorship.
(b) Combining money and skill with simple formation: partnership.
(c) Huge capital, limited liability and continuity: public company.

narration.en: Let us work through this case together. Suggest a form: (a) Anil wants to open a small photocopy shop with ₹50,000 and keep all decisions to himself. (b) Two friends, one with ₹5 lakh and one with technical skill, want to start a repair workshop. (c) Promoters need ₹200 crore for a steel plant and want limited liability.
Roll-call quiz. When your roll number is called, give your answer.
narration.kn: ಹಾಜರಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕ್ರಮಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಕರೆದಾಗ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಉತ್ತರ ಹೇಳಿ.

points.en: No single form suits every business.
Small, personal businesses suit sole proprietorship.
Large-scale business needing huge capital suits a company.
points.kn: ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಬೇಕಾದ ದೊಡ್ಡ ವ್ಯವಹಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಕಂಪನಿ ಸೂಕ್ತ.

points.en: Liability, control and continuity must be weighed together.
points.kn: ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ, ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಮತ್ತು ನಿರಂತರತೆಯನ್ನು ಒಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ತೂಗಬೇಕು.

homework.en: Prepare a chart comparing all five forms on liability, continuity, control and capital.

narration.en: Recap. No single form suits every business. Small, personal businesses suit sole proprietorship. Large-scale business needing huge capital suits a company. Liability, control and continuity must be weighed together.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಎಲ್ಲ ವ್ಯವಹಾರಕ್ಕೂ ಒಂದೇ ಸ್ವರೂಪ ಸೂಕ್ತವಲ್ಲ. ಸಣ್ಣ, ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ವ್ಯವಹಾರಗಳಿಗೆ ಏಕಮಾಲೀಕತ್ವ ಸೂಕ್ತ. ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಬೇಕಾದ ದೊಡ್ಡ ವ್ಯವಹಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಕಂಪನಿ ಸೂಕ್ತ. ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ, ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಮತ್ತು ನಿರಂತರತೆಯನ್ನು ಒಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ತೂಗಬೇಕು.
